name: @acc/decho-foundry-bytes
description: Read large files out of Foundry datasets and media sets from the browser: one token, a resident LRU, Cache Storage keyed by transaction RID, request de-duplication with refcounted cancellation, and concurrency lanes.
//files: src is shipped for the same reason as the sibling packages: the .js.map and .d.ts.map files reference ../src/*, so without it every stack trace and go-to-definition in a consumer dead-ends.
//scripts: No build:deps: this package sits at the bottom of the stack and depends on nothing in this repo. That is the point of extracting it.
//peerDependencies: Deliberately wide, for the reason @acc/decho-basemap learned at 0.1.1: exact @osdk pins made it uninstallable in an app one minor behind. Note there is no maplibre-gl, no pmtiles and no react here — this package has nothing to do with maps.
